title: Dialect binding
preamble:
# Dialect binding

Cross-format provenance binding: the rules and dialect under which
a DS artifact was produced are recorded inside the artifact, and
artifacts that must agree are checked against each other at load
time. Mismatch is fatal.

This document defines the shared binding tuple carried by every versioned
DS artifact (DSC, event trace, DAP trace, RT profile) and the
fail-closed contract that ties them together.

Prefix `RBND`.

Parents this spec inherits:
- [RARC.4] format version discipline — the version side of the
  same fail-closed stance.
- [LDIA] — the dialect mechanism whose resolved
  settings this spec hashes.
